emulator:
openMSX 21.0
flavour: opt
components: CORE GL LASERDISC
workload: Full session, keyboard coin/start and F5 to native round5 (RND4), layout1, three native enemies; frames5..360, fixed directional input
method: Guest emulated seconds * CPU Hz; entry to matched PC/SP return; tracked descendants subtracted for self time
control: 356 camera/tick states match a run without routine breakpoints; total duration matches within5.01cycles; per-frame observation jitter <=5 cycles

limitations: Short directional workload, not a complete phase. Active endpoints require native round5, three enemies, no death/bonus and active session. Excludes118 stopped/death intervals. UI/cold and capture costs use separate controlled event ledgers; never mix their samples with active FPS. Inclusive parents overlap children; never sum them. IRQ spans exclude hardware entry/vector. No physical hardware measurement.

challenge_motion.scope: Committed real-session challenge snapshot after native acceleration; no speed fixtures or native RAM edits.

cold_scope.method: Guest elapsed cycles from routine entry to pre-RET done label; self subtracts tracked nested bodies. CALL/RET instruction overhead remains with the parent or untracked. No parent/child inclusive sum.
cold_scope.scope: Separate controlled full-session integration, native rounds2..14, UI/cold restoration; not part of the active frame statistics.

flag_event.method: Guest elapsed cycles from routine entry to pre-RET done label; self subtracts tracked nested bodies. CALL/RET instruction overhead remains with the parent or untracked. No parent/child inclusive sum.
flag_event.scope: Controlled real flag contact handler,10 captures; clears the normal and S-hidden caches. No recurring overload is hidden as a capture pause.

smoke_regression.scope: Each committed frame checks full HUD/radar and both boundary columns with an independent pixel oracle. Real keyboard only; three native enemies; no native RAM fixtures.

steering.scope: Real keyboard rollover/reversals and Space smoke; no native RAM writes; HUD and sprite limits enabled; native contact cell checked against the selected original maze

original.scope: Original2580 routine at one call per original video tick; clear request28 and contributor RAM seed, no original ROM writes. Original1B03 minimum-settle/1B0A sound-ready waits inspected separately. Controlled sound fixture, not natural playthrough.

clear_cue.scope: All three note voices against original WSG on paired native ticks; PSG period quantization, not waveform/timbre equivalence.

crash.method: DC-removed stereo mean, Hann window, summed Goertzel power at2Hz steps
DC-removed stereo mean, Hann window, summed Goertzel power at2Hz steps

audio.audio_cost_method: Sound-only fixtures; breakpoint at worker entry and exact caller return address before trailing instructions. Guest elapsed inclusive cycles including RET; no tracked child self costs, no active-game FPS claim.
audio.scope: Real PSG worker and openMSX PCM at physical-clock cadence; explicit sound-only fixtures. Direction equality and fundamental tested; subjective arcade timbre remains for user acceptance.

engine_baseline.method: DC-removed PCM RMS at each velocity across all four headings; matched machine/PSG settings

sprite_clip.scope: Synthetic complete-pattern/SAT/color matrix, including vertical/horizontal clips and sentinel216. Component cycles are not integrated FPS.

arcade.scope: Real original first credit/start; explicit seed for subsequent original08BF initialization.32 physical frames observed per round. No original ROM patches or speed-table edits; not naturally completed rounds.

challenge_speed.scope: Actual cartridgeB60C limiter, both velocity signs, normal and parked challenge parameters and fuel-exhaustion exit. Guest entry-through-RET cycles; no full-course or scanout claim.

enemy_rocks.scope: All32 descriptor bytes compared with original181B/1885 collision/rebound, both axes/signs, fine-boundary hits/misses and immunity. Controlled fixtures, not a natural-course proof. Entry-through-RET inclusive cycles; no self-cost sum.

boot_skip.scope: All11 keyboard rows, initial fill, moving RAM test, final matrix, held coin/start/Return keys; title key consumption, release, PSG silence, VDP status selector and access timing. Real keymatrix input, no guest-state writes.

cases.clear_cost_method: Matched entry-to-caller-PC/SP return inclusive guest cycles, including RET/IRQ; no tracked child self costs. Foreground settlement only. begin_bonus includes Completion_Begin; never add parent/child costs.
cases.cold_hook_method: Guest elapsed cycles from routine entry to pre-RET done label; self subtracts tracked nested bodies. CALL/RET instruction overhead remains with the parent or untracked. No parent/child inclusive sum.

original.scope: Original2580 routine at one call per original video tick; clear request28 and contributor RAM seed, no original ROM writes. Original1B03 minimum-settle/1B0A sound-ready waits inspected separately. Controlled sound fixture, not natural playthrough.

clear_sequence.scope: Controlled first-phase normal/S/L last-flag contacts and paused clear; foreground settlement, not VBlank or a scanline hook. Minimum/flag wait and converter-entry groups do not overlap. Converter entry includes the original Completion_Begin child; self costs not separated.

boot.source: Untouched original cold boot, all source refreshes inspected. Lossless hidden-page deltas; bandwidth-limited temporal selection on the original 60.606Hz timeline, mapped to MSX refreshes. Matrix endpoint detected at the exact native refresh; no1.5x acceleration.

engine.scope: Volume-controlled square at the former envelope fundamental; deterministic physical-clock level mixing. PCM attenuation is measured separately.

smoke-arcade.scope: Full original mix; music is not suppressed.

engine-horizontal-arcade.scope: Full original mix; music is not suppressed.

engine-vertical-arcade.scope: Full original mix; music is not suppressed.

motion_reference.scope: Real original coin/start/4-way/smoke input. No guest RAM/ROM writes, forced sound calls or muted voices. Captured wavetable timbre cannot be copied literally into a square-wave PSG.

smoke.scope: Captured rising gated tone, pair-midpoint conversion at30Hz. B is leased only during smoke; A continues music and B is restored immediately. Hardware envelope approximates the square gate; not literal PCM.

crash.scope: C retains gated noise, B adds a100..32Hz falling impact body. Both use cached note packets; B returns to music afterwards. AY timbre is an approximation; final auditory acceptance remains with user.

audio_assets.scope: Pitches, original linear volumes and part/loop order from original WSG execution. AY waveforms remain an approximation; runtime does not execute the original sound CPU.
